image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a comic book cover displayed in a retail rack. The cover features dynamic superhero artwork with a red character (resembling Spider-Man) and a blue character in action poses. The title 'SPIDER-MAN' is partially visible at the top in bold, stylized lettering. The background shows other comic books and rack structures, slightly out of focus.

artifact_observations.location: Top title area and background comics
artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title 'SPIDER-MAN' has distorted letterforms and inconsistent kerning typical of AI generation. Background text on other comics is illegible gibberish.
Slight smudging and lack of crisp line work on the red and blue costumes, resembling digital painting artifacts rather than clean ink lines.
The metal rack structure blends into the background and other objects without clear physical boundaries or logical connection points.
